accounting.index_build: target-independent S3 roots, canonical roots, sparse bucket sorting, singleton tags, and candidate-only batched rational lifts of indexed roots
accounting.target_query: target-dependent query preparation, batched S3 or point-addition partner generation, partner canonicalization, exact tag filtering, and relation checks

comparison_variable: candidate precomputes one rational lift per indexed root before the target clock and generates target partners by batched curve addition; both arms use the same sparse 24-bit bitmap-rank directory, SplitMix64-derived prefix, unrolled N83 basis conversion, early-stop canonicalization, 16-byte records, singleton tags, and exact-key binary search
